VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 13, 2025
  2525 GRAND AVENUE, LONG BEACH, 90815
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

Kenneth Osborn, Chair  James Goodin, Commissioner
Antawnette Atkins Blade, Vice Chair  Hershell Hardimon, Commissioner
Jerry Earl, Commissioner  Nicholas Sramek, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 5:08 PM, Chair Osborn called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Goodin, Hardimon, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Osborn

Commissioners Absent: Earl

Also present: Gina Overholt, Coordinator.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Commissioner Hardimon led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56128  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Veterans Affairs Commission
  meeting of Wednesday, June 4, 2025.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Sramek, seconded by Vice Chair Atkins
  Blade, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Goodin, Hardimon, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Osborn
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Earl

2.  25-56129  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the Veterans Banner
  Program.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Sramek, seconded by Vice Chair Atkins
  Blade, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5 Goodin, Hardimon, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Osborn

  Page 1 of 4
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 13, 2025
  2525 GRAND AVENUE, LONG BEACH, 90815
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Earl

  Chair Osborn provided updates on the banners program. Because of cost savings,
  we were able to install five additional banners for a total of 65. Some adjustments
  were made after the initial installation (on July 10) with a handful of banners being
  relocated because of visibility issues. Public response to the banners is
  overwhelmingly positive. A CBS2 news story on the banners program will air on
  August 26. The possibility of seeking funding for banners in FY 26 will be explored.

  Veterans banner families are invited to mix and mingle at a health services event
  presented by the Wade family (Jabin Wade is a banner honoree) at New Hope on
  August 30. A debrief on the banners program will be scheduled for the banners
  subcommittee. Public comment: Gus Orozco, Long Beach Veterans Day
  Committee president, will organize and a more formal social event for Veterans
  banner families, to take place in September. (VDC will sponsor the event; it is
  seeking additional sponsors as well as a venue now).

3.  25-56130  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the recommendation to
  Council in support of keeping Long Beach Veterans Administration funding and
  jobs intact.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Sramek, seconded by Vice Chair Atkins
  Blade, to approve recommendation, as amended, to [1] approve the draft
  resolution as written, and [2] allow Commissioners Goodin and Osborn to
  transmit copies to the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, the VA Long
  Beach Healthcare System, and members of the California Congressional
  Delegation, and to speak about the matter during public comment at Council.
  The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Goodin, Hardimon, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Osborn
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Earl

  Upon final approval by the Health Department, the resolution will move on to City
  Manager’s office.

4.  25-56131  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on potential changes to Chapter
  2.60 of the Long Beach Municipal Code related to the Veterans Affairs
  Commission.

  Page 2 of 4
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 13, 2025
  2525 GRAND AVENUE, LONG BEACH, 90815
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Atkins Blade, seconded by Commissioner
  Goodin, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Goodin, Hardimon, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Osborn
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Earl

  The Commission reviewed and approved the revised resolution, as approved by the
  City Attorney’s Office. Upon final approval by the Health Department, the resolution
  will move on to City Manager’s office.

5.  25-56132  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on a proposed housing project
  for Veterans at 1400 Cherry Avenue.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Hardimon, seconded by Commissioner
  Sramek, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Goodin, Hardimon, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Osborn
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Earl

  Commissioners were advised to follow a formal transparent process coordinated by
  their staff liaison when it comes to providing advice and recommendations to the
  Mayor and City Council. Commissioners may express their support for city projects
  and programs, such as Veterans-related development projects, by writing letters or
  designating Commissioners to speak on the matter during public comment at a
  Council meeting, as examples, but not in the early stages of a project. Commission
  processes exist to ensure fairness, equal access, and public confidence.

6.  25-56133  Recommendation to discuss and approve the Veterans Affairs Commission’s
  Annual Report.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Atkins Blade, seconded by Commissioner
  Sramek, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5 Goodin, Hardimon, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Osborn
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None

  Page 3 of 4
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 13, 2025
  2525 GRAND AVENUE, LONG BEACH, 90815
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 1 Earl

  The Commission reviewed and approved the draft Annual Report revised
  resolution, as approved by the City Attorney’s Office. Upon final approval by the
  Health Department, the resolution will move on to City Manager’s office.

7.  25-56134  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the Veterans Day Celebration
  on November 8, 2025.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Atkins Blade, seconded by Commissioner
  Sramek, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Goodin, Hardimon, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Osborn
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Earl

  A Veterans Day subcommittee was established with Commissioners Sramek,
  Hershell, Blade and Goodin as members. A kick off meeting with Special Events will
  take place on August 19.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Seth Silberstein spoke.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Two Veteran Stand Down events coming up: one from September 20-22, at the Compton Housing
Authority in Compton, and the other on October 3, 2025, at Grijalva Park in Orange. Shuttle pickups
at VA Long Beach.

ADJOURNMENT

At 6:45 PM, there being no objection, Chair Osborn declared the meeting adjourned.
